title: Wandering will not cool this fire
summary: The line does not reward endless circling; it asks for trust, keeping, and return. Keep this close: Hold onto this: doubt clears when the Guru's word outlasts wandering.
takeaway: Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
lifeApplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until the breathing slows.

source.shortMeaning: The fire of doubt cools through Gurmukh steadiness, not roaming.
source.lifeApplication: When confusion surges, stay with the line before you run to another distraction.
